description: The official Disney Lorcana card back (decision D28) for face-down cards: the pack reveal, the match scene, the opponent's hand, decks and the inkwell. The file is byte-identical to its source and is shown unchanged; the browser scales it.

source.project: The Director's original Inkspire app, /home/andre/the-inkspire (commit b7b876ba)
source.legacy_record: The Inkspire's asset catalog (packages/assets/src/catalog.ts), key material.card.back: type official-source, note 'Official card back reused as-is.', approval owner-approved-2026-07-02
source.origin_note: Where the file came from before LorcanaOnline is not recorded beyond the legacy catalog's official-source note.

file.colour_space: sRGB assumed: no embedded ICC profile
file.rendition: Card back, full size; corners rounded by the card silhouette rule in CSS
file.language: None: the back carries no text

accessibility: Decorative where the surrounding context names the face-down cards (for example "Opponent's hand, 7 cards"); otherwise CardBack takes a label such as "Face-down card".
fallback: With DesignSystemProvider officialAssets={false}, CardBack draws a neutral back from the tokens (paper surface, ink rule, no product marks) in the same silhouette (fan-content policy rule 4).
not_used: The same legacy folder holds a 734 x 1024 copy with rounded corners baked into transparency, a 3583 x 5000 upscale and recoloured variants (cosmos, white, yellow); none is used.
